liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the jam leading in is the highlight: Phil drives it forcefully, backs off, then returns while Jerry toys with the theme; Reviewer, seated in the Phil zone, loves Phil's playing on this song [6][13]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Reviewer, who wasn't there, singles out this version of the song as a favorite [11]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer loves the a cappella jam, with Phil joining in as in the early days [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-12.nak300.cousinit.24494.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 192 min [1]
- **gd93-09-12.dsbd.miller.28783.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd93-09-12.sony.vernon.18529.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording good and worth downloading, especially for people who attended [9]
- **gd1993-09-12.schoeps-Litzenberger.watson.85663.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had a front-row spot in the Phil zone, obtained through mail order tickets [10]
- Reviewer used a spare ticket for this Sunday night show on a first date with his future wife, who became a fan [12]
- Reviewer preferred the 13 September 1993 show and thinks this run mixes the year's great and flat shows [9]
- Reviewer ranks the show, especially its second set, among the top ten of 1993 [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-12.nak300.cousinit.24494.shnf**: taped by Cousinit; transferred by Cousinit; source: Denon DTR80P DAT Deck w/ Nak 300 Shotguns>MDAT>WAV>SHN [1]
- **gd93-09-12.dsbd.miller.28783.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD -> Master Dat (48k) [2]. Also: Soundboard from a 48k master DAT, transferred via Sony 500 DAT, Behringer SRC2000, SEK'D Prodif Plus and Samplitude to FLAC by Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd93-09-12.sony.vernon.18529.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raoul Duke and Matt Vernon; source: Audience: Sony C-38B's [3]
- **gd1993-09-12.schoeps-Litzenberger.watson.85663.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger & Ed K.; transferred by Watson; source: Schoeps MK4's>Reutelhuber Preamp>Technics SVM-D1 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-09-13 The Spectrum, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-09-13-the-spectrum-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Spectrum - September 12, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/september-12-1993) [21]
